title: Reasoning Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 batch of the CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE master ticket (26/08/05). Merge the 💡️reasoning plugin's 7 Rust crates (bundle/manifest + app facade + engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui modules for its one app, 🔌️wires) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/💡️reasoning/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (crate name preserved from the old bundle crate: semio-s-plugin-reasoning-mindmap), with the full taxonomy source tree (🗿️artifacts/wires/{component,diff,op,dsl,pack,spr,engine}, 🎛️apps/wires/{component,config,terminology,commands,modes,panels}) wired from a plugin-root 📦️lib.rs via explicit #[path] mod declarations. Decompose WiresCommand with the app_commands! macro, stitch the manifest from per-node definition() fns, preserve wire format exactly, keep every existing test. Follow TEMPLATE.md precisely (already written by the W1 flow pilot). Fix the known systemic pre-existing broken-ui-crate bug (unclosed Ok(Emit::... parens + missing Fault import) documented in TEMPLATE.md §12.3 - present in this plugin's old ui crate too. Repoint the one external dependent found (framework os-dev's dsl fixture-sweep crate, which dev-depends on reasoning_wires for MindmapWiresDocument). Never touch root Cargo.toml / launch.json / registry script / other plugins - report the registrar handoff lines instead.
summary:
W2 batch migration of the 💡️reasoning plugin's 7 Rust crates (bundle/manifest + app facade + engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui modules for its one app, 🔌️wires) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-reasoning-mindmap` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/💡️reasoning/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, with the full taxonomy source tree wired from a plugin-root `📦️lib.rs`.

Structure: `🗿️artifacts/🔌️wires/{🦀️component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine}` (📡️protocol renamed to 📡️spr; the old hand-derived `WiresCommand` enum dropped from spr and rebuilt at app level via `app_commands!`) and `🎛️apps/🔌️wires/{🦀️component,🦀️config,🦀️terminology, 🎮️commands×8, 🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/🕸️canvas, 📌️panels×3}`. The 12-variant `WiresCommand` is rebuilt with `app_commands!` (keyed `"id" as "wire-key"` form, no ctx needed — this app has no extra dispatch-context state). `DocumentApp::handle` is one line (`command.dispatch(doc, cfg)`); the manifest is stitched from per-node `definition()` fns via the `.mode_def()`/`.window_kind_def()`/`.panel_tab_def()` passthroughs.

Wire format proven unchanged: a pre-migration dump of `print_op | len | hex` for all 13 samples (12 command variants, `CanvasPointerDown` sampled twice for its `Option` field) diffs byte-identical against the post-migration dump (both saved in this ticket folder as `🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt`/`🧪️wire-after.txt`; the temporary `[DEBUG]` dump tests used to capture them were removed from both the old and new crates once the diff was confirmed clean).

Verification (temporary nested `[workspace]` overlay used for isolated builds while the old same-named bundle crate was still a member; overlay removed before this close): `cargo check` clean, `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean, `cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2` succeeded (full cdylib link), `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo test` 65/65 green (baseline across the 7 old crates + bundle was 43, every old test preserved plus new taxonomy-node-level tests).

Systemic pre-existing broken-ui-crate bug (TEMPLATE.md §12.3 pattern) confirmed present in this plugin too and fixed as part of the port: the old `🖱️ui` crate's `handle()` was missing `Fault` from its `semio_framework_plugin` import, had one `Ok(Emit::operations(operations)` with a missing closing paren, and two `return Ok(Emit::default()` (also missing closing parens) — plus 3 MORE bare `Emit { .. }` match arms (AddNode/AddRelationship/DeleteSelection) that TEMPLATE's cad/vcs/shooting writeup didn't call out, returned without the `Ok(...)` wrapper the `Result` return type requires. All fixed identically in both the temporarily-restored old crate (to establish a compiling baseline) and the new `app_commands!` handlers.

External dependent fixed: `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep`'s Cargo.toml + `📦️lib.rs` dev-depended on the old `reasoning_wires` app-facade crate for `MindmapWiresDocument` — repointed to the new merged crate (`reasoning_mindmap_plugin` alias, package `semio-s-plugin-reasoning-mindmap`, path `✏️s/🔌️plugins/💡️reasoning/📦️packages/🦀️rust`) and the `use` path updated to `reasoning_mindmap_plugin::artifacts::wires::MindmapWiresDocument`. No `🎪️demonstrator` dependency found (grepped, empty). No other cross-plugin dependents found (only root Cargo.toml and this one fixture-sweep crate referenced the old crate names, exactly as TEMPLATE predicted).

Orphan data files relocated (old crate directories deleted, so these needed a new home): `📚️examples/🔌️metabolism.wires` → `🗿️artifacts/🔌️wires/📚️examples/🔌️metabolism.wires` (the `.wires` DSL include_str! target); the odd-named `🛂️manifest/🛂️manifest.jsonwires.manifest.json` (unreferenced by any live code, confirmed via repo-wide grep) → `🗿️artifacts/🔌️wires/🛂️manifest.json`, mirroring flow's identical precedent.

Old crate dirs deleted only after all checks passed: `🛂️manifest/`, `🎛️apps/🔌️wires/⚡️implementations/`, `🎛️apps/🔌️wires/🔨️modules/`. Root workspace is now red on exactly the 8 dangling old member lines + the fixture-sweep repoint until the registrar pass (see the registrar-handoff details below — never touched root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/launch.json/registry script myself).
